_note: The armory (src/game/armory.ts): SpeedKills' range's back wall, where the legacy racks by ammo type stood, holding the ten guns on the left of the middle gate and the ten hacks on its right, each on a stand of the pack's own case with its hologram over it and a screen on the wall behind (the owner, 2026-09-30: 'show all hacks and guns in that similar style to Hyper Scape ... make each hack and gun have a tv behind it showing details on the gun, what it is, how to fuse'). Hyper Scape's training room had every gun and hack out to try; its loot stood as a hologram turning over the floor, its hacks on amber cards, which is what the stands draw. `z` is where a stand's middle is (the back wall's face is at 8, the firing line's at -4); `spacing` m between stands along a run of wall; `item` is the hologram's height and its turn (radians a second) and bob (m); `card` the hologram card over it; `tv` the screen on the wall (its middle's height, its size, and its canvas's width in pixels); `reach` how near a stand E takes from and `facing` the least cosine between your look and the way to it.
_spacing: 2.4 m, not the run's full share: seven stands fill the 17.5 m between two gates with 0.35 m spare at each end, so the screens (2.2 m) keep clear of the gates' lit posts, which stand 0.1 m out from the gate, and of the sign over the middle gate (4.6 m wide, from 3.8 m up).
_card: The card's top stays under 2.1 m: from where E reaches a stand (2.2 m out) an eye at 1.5 m sees the screen's foot (2.55 m) over it.
_screen: The screen's type, in canvas pixels (896 across 2.2 m: about 2.5 mm a pixel). Sized so the rows read from where E reaches: a 38 px row is about 9 cm of type, 12 px on a 720-line screen at the game's field of view from 3 m. `rowH` the table's line pitch, `band` the lit strip along the foot that says how to take and fuse.
_solid: A stand's case as the player collides with it, about the stand's middle on the floor (x along the wall, z toward it): its box as it stands with its cover open, MEASURED off the loaded case (__range.armory() stands[].box, armory.ts caseBox; 2026-10-01: 1.224 m across, 0.970 m to the open cover's top, 0.342 m in front of the middle to 0.531 m behind it, the same for the gun's white case and the hack's black one). The skarmory check holds every stand to it, within 3 cm. Without it you walked through the cases and stood in the hologram.
_colors: The gun's amber is the hack card's own (hackcast.ts), so a gun's card and a hack's read as one set; a hack wears its slot's colour as its core does on a match's floor (loot.ts: mobility cyan, utility magenta).
_order: Left to right. The guns' run goes from the side wall in to the middle gate, the most played nearest the spawn; the hacks' run goes out from the gate, the mobility hacks first.
